statement_refuted: One exact-zero physical bilinear row with bounded-density shear by itself yields a uniform signed-Fejer bound.
counterexample: For iid X,U Uniform[-1/2,1/2], T=2XU has density log(1/(2|t|)) on 0<|t|<1/2. Under the account04/B01 Fejer kernel, D_T(0)=log T+O(1) as T tends to infinity.
scope_note: The two-variable quadratic form has eigenvalues +1 and -1 only, so this is not a counterexample to the three-large-eigenvalue QFORM target. It proves a third curvature/product resource must be spent before closing a uniform signed-Fejer estimate.
